decided: The structured form of the reader's brief now also carries the brief's printed text, so one run of the command gives a review both the text it hands the reader and the list of records it then records as read.
alternatives: run the command twice, once for the text and once for the list
take the list of records from the headings of the printed text
why: Two runs could disagree when a record is written between them, and a record the reader never saw would then be recorded as read and never read; one run cannot disagree with itself.

defines.definition: the text orbit prints for the reader of the decision records: the architecture doc, each record to read and what it points at, and the reader's task
